title: Era
description: An era. Era N+1 begins when the tech gateway and the civic gateway of era N are complete. One file per era in content/eras/<id>.json.

order.description: The era's number, 1 for the first; unique across eras. Items name an era by this number.

requires.description: The gateways that must be complete before the era begins. Every era after the first has them; the first does not.

tech.description: A tech with gateway: true that belongs to the previous era.

civic.description: A civic with gateway: true that belongs to the previous era.
